absence.authoritative_source: 待指定的签名 G2 mapping registry/attestor
absence.recovery_condition: provide signed mapping plus key/certificate, validity, revocation and anti-replay evidence; then independently verify exact candidate binding
absence.expiry_condition: mapping policy, source, candidate or trust material changes

present_admission_requirements.effective_interval: not_before/not_after plus trusted_time and freshness window
present_admission_requirements.signature: algorithm, signature bytes, key id, certificate chain, policy OID/EKU/key usage/name constraints
present_admission_requirements.trust_root: externally verifiable root and key fingerprint
present_admission_requirements.revocation: status plus OCSP/CRL source, checked_at, freshness and trusted time
present_admission_requirements.anti_replay: fresh nonce/request id and idempotency binding
present_admission_requirements.ambiguity: unique decision with no competing entries
present_admission_requirements.binding: source/candidate/evidence/axis refs and hashes exact in both directions
present_admission_requirements.strict_object_policy: duplicate keys and unknown fields reject at every object; each listed security field is typed-checked
present_admission_requirements.promotion: only after all fields independently verified; otherwise typed_absent or fail_closed
